record.hypothesis: Question. Does one aggregate decode use fewer resources than many simultaneous small decodes at the same total pixel rate? What differs from earlier work. Opposite tradeoff to R84 spatial selection: aggregate when many regions are visible instead of avoiding unneeded regions. Input scope. Prepared synchronized clips or views sharing a presentation timeline; first 4 or 9 equal-sized views. Mechanism to test. Encode a mosaic into one video stream, decode once and sample the corresponding regions for independent visual placements.
